description: A Lua script for setting up a graphical window and drawing a point that follows the mouse cursor, demonstrating basic graphics operations.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes the graphical window with dimensions 400x400.

methods.name: draw
methods.description: Draws the background, some instructional text, and a point at the current mouse position.

calls: text('Point example, move the mouse around', 40, 40)
